about_the_game:
UFOntastic is an exploration-based adventure game where the main mechanic is to absorb objects from the environment.

You can use your flying saucer to abduct objects, characters, or enemies, and then use them to overcome the various dungeons. Try to collect valuable objects so that the protagonist, Jano, can sell them and pay off his outstanding debt. But be careful not to attract too much attention during your adventure, as some characters may attack you or even call the police to arrest you.

-MAKE A FORTUNE... USING JUST ONE BUTTON?
Using just one button, you can abduct people or absorb objects. Use them to overcome the different challenges! The simple controls allow anyone to play, but that doesn't mean it will be easy to overcome the trials that await you: obstacle courses, multiple quests, enemies, and bosses to defeat. Will you be able to overcome them?

A CITY?

Explore various locations throughout the city and face labyrinthine dungeons filled with mini-games. Completing them will give you access to a boss, and if you defeat it, you may earn a great reward for Jano.

-COMPETE IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER... OR ONLINE!

Up to 10 different minigames to compete in 1v1 battles with your friends! And distance won't be an issue, as you can play against Steam friends using their Remote Play system. Compete to see who is the number one spaceship pilot!

-HAND-DRAWN GRAPHICS ACCOMPANIED BY GREAT MUSIC!

Immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere, filled with comical hand-drawn animations and original themes that enliven the different locations to explore. Will you find yourself humming one of the tunes even after you've closed the game?

-ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

Hello, my name is Kenneth, and I am developing UFOntastic, where I am in charge of programming, art, and mechanics.

This is one of the games I have enjoyed the most during the creation process, perhaps because it is a more relaxed idea focused on comedy. I hope that if you buy it, you will enjoy it as much as I do. Thank you very much for your support!

  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: A monitor with 60Hz refresh rate
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Jano has debts to pay, and the easiest place to get money is on Earth! Use your flying saucer: abduct objects, people, enemies and much more from the environment to progress through dungeons and mini-games.  Amass a fortune!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, French, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
